responsibility: Implements the non-vector RISC-V builtin subsystem. It declares builtin prototypes from riscv-ftypes.def, registers target-dependent builtin functions for floating-point flag access, cache-management operations, and scalar crypto instructions using availability predicates, expands builtin calls to the corresponding .md patterns, delegates RVV builtin classes to the vector subsystem, and provides target hooks for builtin declaration, folding, expansion, and atomic floating-point environment save/restore.
